description: This file defines the IdentityProviderException class, a custom exception used within the OAuth2 client library to represent errors returned by the provider. It extends the base PHP Exception class and includes additional functionality to store and retrieve the response body associated with the error.

classes.name: IdentityProviderException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends PHP's base Exception to include additional response data from an OAuth2 provider error.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the exception with a message, code, and response body.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Returns the response body associated with the exception.
